# Phase Two — Revenue Failure Attack

- Revenue cannot be guaranteed; engineering can only improve discoverability, value, conversion, retention, and unit economics.
- Do not add dark patterns, fake scarcity, forced paywalls, or pay-to-win mechanics.
- Do not publish SEO pages whose product route is broken or whose capability is unavailable.
- Do not track private user content in analytics.
- Do not let marketing metadata drift from canonical product identity.
- Do not spend credits before value is provably delivered.
- Do not lose user work when login/purchase intervenes.
- Do not introduce subscription commitments before cancellation/refund/support policy exists.
- Do not scale acquisition before core product performance and mobile quality are measurable.
- Do not optimize conversion without tracking post-purchase success and retention.
